questlog.editor.title: Questlog Editor
questlog.quest.welcome.hint1: If you happen to have any questions - we will be happy to answer them on our
questlog.quest.welcome.title: Welcome!
questlog.quest.welcome.description:
Hello, traveler!

You have found yourself in the mysterious world of §lCreate Eternal Journey§r!

A brief overview of the modpack:
The whole idea revolves around the fact that §oyou§r - an ordinary person, who knows nothing about magic, end up in an amazing magical world. Travel, explore and conquer its vastness, and perhaps one day, you will be able to master §d§lmagic§r itself!

§lQuests§r in this modpack serve as a kind of guide. 
The §nCreate§r tab will teach you the basics of the mod, as well as introduce you to useful addons, while the §nEternal Journey§r tab will help you navigate the progression and introduce you to unique content!

Enjoy exploring and have a happy, §lEternal Journey§r!
questlog.quest.antique_atlas.title: Antique Atlas
questlog.quest.antique_atlas.description:
The modpack includes a world map - Antique Atlas

How to use:
• Press §6§l[M]§r to open the map
• The map automatically fills in as you explore the world
• You can place markers and waypoints
• Holding §6§l[ALT]§r shows additional information

You can also craft the map as an item and open it manually. To do this, combine a book with a compass, or simply rename a book to "antique atlas".
questlog.quest.cold_sweat.title: Time to dress up
questlog.quest.cold_sweat.description:
Well, well! Extreme §ltemperature§r spares no one, so it's time to learn how to fight it!

The most universal way to protect yourself is to sew certain materials into your armor at the [Sewing Table](image:questlog:textures/icons/sewing_table.png). Different materials provide different types of resistance.

As an alternative, you can use potions of Cold Resistance and Fire Resistance, as well as [Waterskins](image:questlog:textures/icons/waterskin.png).

And don't forget that your temperature is also affected by the blocks around you, such as lava, ice, or a [Hearth](image:questlog:textures/icons/hearth.png).
questlog.quest.diet.title: Diet
questlog.quest.diet.description:
§lFood§r is one of the most important mechanics in the modpack, and it has also undergone major changes

§lFood Variety:§r
From now on, when eating the same food, the saturation it restores will gradually §ndecrease all the way down to 0§r. Saturation gradually returns when you eat §ndifferent types of food§r.

§lMaintain a Balanced Diet:§r
Each food provides its own stats, and by following a certain diet, you can gain various bonuses!

§lFood Stats:§R
• Fruits
• Grains
• Proteins
• Vegetables
• Sugars

Maintain a balanced diet and combine effects for the best results. Bon appétit!
questlog.quest.zoom.title: Zoom!
questlog.quest.zoom.description:
During your journey, you will often find yourself searching for things on the horizon. In such cases, you will definitely need a §nspyglass§r!

§lWhat's new?§r
• Quick-use spyglass with the hotkey §6§l[C]§r
• The spyglass can be worn in the belt slot
• The spyglass overlay can be toggled off in a config
questlog.quest.difficulty.title: Raids and difficulty
questlog.quest.difficulty.description:
By frequently killing undead mobs, you may summon an §lUndead Army§r upon yourself.

Moreover, the difficulty of the modpack §nincreases over time§r, and the undead raids grow stronger alongside it. §oNightmarish§r entities will join the army, and their abilities and stats will increase over time.

By the way, you can deliberately summon a raid by crafting a [Undead Battle Standart](image:questlog:textures/icons/standart.png).
questlog.quest.corpses.title: Death
questlog.quest.corpses.description:
Sometimes, §ldeath§r is the inevitable end of many adventures, and to soften this unpleasant event, we came up with the following:

From now on, upon dying, you, like any adventurer, will leave behind your §nskeleton§r at the place of death, which will keep inside §nall your items§r.

§lFeatures:§r
• The corpse does not burn or explode.
• To get back your items, you need to break the corpse.
• The appearance of the corpse depends on the circumstances of your death.

§c§l⚠ Warning, possible conflicts:§r
• The [Reactor](image:questlog:textures/icons/reactor.png) and [Back Modules](image:questlog:textures/icons/back_slot.png) from the §oProtection Pixel§r mod are not preserved.
• Upon death from the [Unequal Exchange](image:questlog:textures/icons/unequal_exchange.png) curse, your items will not be saved.
questlog.quest.andesite.title: Andesite alloy
questlog.quest.andesite.description:
Let's start with the basics!

§lAndesite Alloy§r is a key resource in the §oCreate§r mod. It is used in almost all machines, so we recommend stocking up on it!

§oTip: The most efficient way to produce the alloy is to mix it in a basin.
questlog.quest.basecomponents.title: Basic components
questlog.quest.basecomponents.descriptio:
From §landesite alloy§r, the basic components of the mod are crafted. These include §nshafts§r, §ncogs§r, §nandesite casings§r, etc.

While cogs and shafts are crafted the usual way, on a crafting table, to make an andesite casing, you'll need to do the following:
• Place a log of wood
• Strip it
• Press §6§l[RMB]§r on the stripped wood with an andesite alloy 

§oBy the way, if you hold the §6§l[W]§r§o key while hovering over almost any item or block from Create, you will see a brief and clear guide about it!§r
questlog.quest.energy.title: Energy sources
questlog.quest.energy.description:
Every machine runs on energy. In our case - on §lrotational energy§r. 

There are many ways to generate it, but each has its own pros and cons. The most common ones are:
• Water wheels
• Windmills
• Steam boilers
• Diesel generators 

§oIn the early game, we recommend choosing water wheels or windmills (they can be easily found in the world), but as your needs grow, you'll have to switch to something more serious.§r
questlog.quest.machines.title: Mechanisms
questlog.quest.machines.description:
Great, we're almost there. The next thing you'll learn about is mechanisms.

By using rotational energy, you can power various machines. They will unlock a vast array of functionality for all sorts of needs. The most useful ones at your stage are:
• [Press](image:questlog:textures/icons/press.png)
• [Mixer](image:questlog:textures/icons/mixer.png)
• [Mullstone](image:questlog:textures/icons/millstone.png)
• [Saw](image:questlog:textures/icons/saw.png)
• [Drill](image:questlog:textures/icons/drill.png) 

§oTo learn how to use a particular mechanism, hold §6§l[W]§r§o while hovering over the item.§r
questlog.quest.alloys.title: Alloys!
questlog.quest.alloys.description:
Another mechanic of the §oCreate§r mod is §lheating§r.

Sometimes, certain recipes require a specific heat level. The Blaze Burner will help us achieve the required heat.
To obtain it, press §6§l[RMB]§r with an [empty blaze burner](image:questlog:textures/icons/empty_burner.png) on a Blaze or its spawner.

Using the heat from the burner, you can obtain unique resources, such as Brass. (You will definitely need it.)

§oBy the way, the modpack includes a craft for the §d§lCreative Blaze Cake§r§o. It will not only allow you to adjust the desired heat level, but also make Blaze working indefinitely!§r
questlog.quest.activators.title: Deployers
questlog.quest.activators.description:
§lDeployer§r is one of the most versatile blocks in the §oCreate§r mod. It allows you to §nsimulate§r player interactions, making it possible to automate almost anything!

Moreover, placing several deployers in a row creates a mechanism for §nsequential assembly§r. 
This is a very important mechanic that will allow you to create advanced contraptions!
questlog.quest.crafter.title: Mechanical crafting
questlog.quest.crafter.description:
The last thing we'll cover in our brief guide is §lmechanical crafting§r

This mechanic not only allows you to automate §ncrafting table recipes§r, but also unlocks access to advanced items that require a crafting grid larger than 3x3!

§oThe recipe for the Mechanical Crafter has been slightly changed. You will now need to craft a Precision Mechanism for it.
questlog.quest.jetpacks.title: To the skies!
questlog.quest.jetpacks.description:
The addon §oCreate Stuff & Additions§r gives us a lot of useful items, the most indispensable of which are the §ljetpacks§r!

A jetpack allows you to lift yourself some blocks above the §nsurface§r, significantly improving your mobility. The lift height and flight speed depend on the type of jetpack.

There are 4 types of jetpacks:
• [Copper Jetpack](image:questlog:textures/icons/copper_bp.png)
• [Andesite Jetpack](image:questlog:textures/icons/andesite_bp.png)
• [Brass Jetpack](image:questlog:textures/icons/brass_bp.png)
• [Netherite Jetpack](image:questlog:textures/icons/netherite_bp.png)

Each jetpack consumes a specific resource while in use. To store them, you will need special tanks:
• [Filling tank](image:questlog:textures/icons/liquid_tank.png)
• [Fueling tank](image:questlog:textures/icons/fuel_tank.png)
• [Creative filling tank](image:questlog:textures/icons/creative_tank.png) (universal and infinite)
questlog.quest.trades.title: Let there be business!
questlog.quest.trades.description:
Have you ever dreamed of automating trades with villagers? Well, now it's possible!

§lTrading Depot§r will allow you to automatically trade with villagers by simply supplying them with resources. Moreover, it also allows you to §nignore§r their trade quantity limits!
The only catch is that villagers still don't trade at night.
questlog.quest.loaders.title: Chunk loaders
questlog.quest.loaders.description:
You'll often have to leave your base, causing your factories to idle. The addon §oCreate: Power Loader§r will help us with this problem!

Craft an [empty chunk loader](image:questlog:textures/icons/chunk_loader.png), then use it on a ghast to capture it. This way, you will obtain a working chunk loader.

There are two types:
• Andesite Chunk Loader
• Brass Chunk Loader

§oKeep in mind that chunk loaders put a heavy load on the network and do not work at very low rotational speeds.
questlog.quest.enchanting.title: Enchanting automatisation
questlog.quest.enchanting.description:
§oEnchantment Industry§r is an addon that allows you to manage experience and enchantments using the §oCreate§r mod.

With this addon, you can extract experience from a player using a §nDisenchanter§r and treat it like a fluid, while the §nEnchanting Guide§r will allow your Blaze Burners to automatically enchant your gear.

§c§l⚠ Important:§r
As a result of rebalancing, the mod has been made more difficult. To craft Enchanting Guide or the Printer, you will now need a new item - the [Enchanting Mechanism](image:questlog:textures/icons/enchanting_mechanism.png).

The recipe for Hyper Experience has also been made more difficult. Since experience itself is a manifestation of magic, the Hyper Experience recipe now requires §dmagic dust§r as a catalyst.
questlog.quest.crushing.title: Crushing
questlog.quest.crushing.description:
§lCrushing Wheels§r allow you to crush various ores for additional resources.

They can also be used to recycle some items by breaking them down into their components in a certain ratio.

§oWell, well - I definitely shouldn't stick my fingers in there...
questlog.quest.fishing.title: A Net Gain
questlog.quest.fishing.description:
One of the most non-obvious sources of resources can now be §lfishing§r!

Thanks to the §oCreate: Fishery Industry§r addon, you can build huge networks of [Frame Traps](image:questlog:textures/icons/frame_trap.png) that will automatically catch fish and other resources.

Overall, the addon adds many useful blocks and items, such as the [Mechanical Peeler](image:questlog:textures/icons/peeler.png) or the [Harpoon Gun](image:questlog:textures/icons/harpoon.png). There's plenty of functionality - we recommend checking it out.
questlog.quest.fluid.title: Working with fluids
questlog.quest.fluid.description:
The addon §oCreate: Fluid§r greatly simplifies the storage and transportation of fluids.

Some things that you will likely find useful:

• [Can Filler](image:questlog:textures/icons/can_filler.png) - allows you to package fluids into copper cans for more convenient transport (functionally similar to boxes).

• [Fluid Interface](image:questlog:textures/icons/interface.png) - makes interacting with fluid containers much easier.

• [Copper Sink](image:questlog:textures/icons/sink.png) - simply a compact infinite water source.

§o...and much more. We recommend exploring this addon yourself - there's definitely a lot to see!
questlog.quest.chanelling.title: Sea breeze
questlog.quest.chanelling.description:
§lConduit Cage§r is a new block from the addon §oCreate Aquatic Ambitions§r.

First and foremost, it unlocks a new way of processing resources - §nChanneling§r.

Additionally, the cage can be awakened by filling it with a fluid. In that state, it will apply effects around itself based on the fluid used.
questlog.quest.eggs.title: Poultry farm
questlog.quest.eggs.description:
Did you know eggs can be automated?

That's right! With the Create: Egg Production addon, you can craft an [Empty Egg Producer](image:questlog:textures/icons/egg_collector.png) and catch a chicken in it. Supply it with water and seeds, and you'll have an egg generator!

The mod also adds an [Incubator](image:questlog:textures/icons/incubator.png), which does the opposite - it takes eggs as input and produces chickens or their resources.
questlog.quest.oil.title: WTF is a kilometer?!
questlog.quest.oil.description:
Do we even need to explain this addon?

§lOil§r, §lengines§r, §lturrets§r - all these blessings of civilization are brought to you by the addon §oCreate: Diesel Generators§r!

On top of that, it also adds many unique mechanics, such as [Bulk Fermenter](image:questlog:textures/icons/fermenter.png) or the [Burner](image:questlog:textures/icons/burner.png).

§oThere's a lot of content here - we can't fit it all into one quest, so good luck exploring! :)
questlog.quest.electricity.title: Electricity
questlog.quest.electricity.description:
Another legendary addon!

§oCreate Crafts & Additions§r introduces §lelectricity§r into the game, which can now be generated using rotational power and conveniently transported via cables.

But the addon doesn't stop there! It also adds a [Straw](image:questlog:textures/icons/straw.png), allowing you to feed liquid fuel directly into your blaze burners.
questlog.quest.drones.title: Bluetooth storage?
questlog.quest.drones.description:
...Well, almost. §oCreate: Mobile Packages§r adds a convenient alternative to package frogports - the §lRobo Bee Port§r.

Its main difference from frogports is that it can deliver packages not only to other bee ports, but also §ndirectly to the player§r.

You can also craft a [Portable Stock Ticker](image:questlog:textures/icons/controller.png) for remote package ordering!
questlog.quest.protection.title: Heavy armor
questlog.quest.protection.description:
Have you ever dreamed of powerful heavy armor? 
Well, with the §oCreate: Protection Pixel§r addon, that dream becomes a reality!

The addon adds many different armor pieces, each with its own unique features.

Armor in this mod requires energy, specifically - a [Combustion Reactor](image:questlog:textures/icons/reactor.png) installed. To power it, open it with §6§l[RMB]§r and insert a [Disposable Water Tank](image:questlog:textures/icons/watertank.png) and [Flare Rods](image:questlog:textures/icons/flarerod.png).

The reactor's level determines how many §narmor plates§r you can install on your suit. To install them, you'll need a special [Armor Load Platform](image:questlog:textures/icons/platform.png).

In addition to helmets, chestplates, and leggings, the mod also adds back modules. These are also installed using the platform.

§oThe mod is slightly buggy and has a number of conflicts. Be careful and don't forget to read the [warning below](quest:questlog:main_quests/corpses) (click the link).
questlog.quest.dimensions.title: Through dimensions
questlog.quest.dimensions.description:
Forget about transportation problems! The addon §oCreate Utilities§r allows you to instantly move anything, anywhere!

To perform such space-bending operations, we'll need to turn to technomagic - specifically, to craft an [Interdimensional Mechanism](image:questlog:textures/icons/interdim.png). Then, by creating void devices, you can link them together by setting the same frequency. After that, anything that goes into the first device will arrive at the second!

Available enderite devices:
• Void Motor
• Void Chest
• Void Tank
• Void Battery
questlog.quest.elythra.title: Weightless sphere
questlog.quest.elythra.description:
§cThere's no more Elytra.§r 

Instead, in End cities you will now find the §lweightless sphere§r. With it, you can create a mechanical counterpart to the Elytra - and even better!

§oThe weightless sphere also allows you to craft a [Gravity Core](image:questlog:textures/icons/core.png)§o, if you're unlucky enough not to get one from the enigmatic dice.
questlog.quest.sphere.title: Sphere of Eternity
questlog.quest.sphere.description:
§cThe "Mending" enchantment book has been removed from the game!§r

§nReason:§r
• It was too easy to obtain
• Made items eternal with minimal effort

§lWhat replaces it?§r

§d§lAlloyed Sphere of Eternity!§r - a powerful device that allows you to make any item §nunbreakable§r by combining them on an anvil!

§oThe sphere is also a component in many unique items - explore the recipes with JEI!
questlog.quest.goggles.title: I see
questlog.quest.goggles.description:
Many of you may be familiar with the mod §oJade§r.

In this modpack, it is implemented through §nengineer's goggles§r. You can still see information about blocks and mobs, but only while wearing them.

§oFor convenience, the goggles can be equipped in the Curios slot.
questlog.quest.relics.title: Relics
questlog.quest.relics.description:
A great deal of attention has been given to §lrelics§r in this modpack. They are the most vivid manifestation of §omagic§r in this world, and therefore hold great importance for your progression.

§lWhat's new:§r
• Relic rebalance (progression slowed down, some relics disabled, relic rarity split into 3 tiers).
• [Relic Experience Bottle](image:questlog:textures/icons/relic_bottle.png) can now be crafted.
• Relics can be crushed to obtain a [Pinch of Magic Dust](image:questlog:textures/icons/magic_pinch.png) and a [Relic Experience Nugget](image:questlog:textures/icons/relic_nugget.png).
• The recipe for [Mimi Dust](image:questlog:textures/icons/mimi.png) has been changed.

§oRelics can be found in various dungeons all over the world. Some are more common, others rarer. Happy hunting!
questlog.quest.find.title: Found it!
questlog.quest.find.description:
The previous §ocivilizations§r have collapsed, but that works in your favor! Now, while exploring the world, you can find many abandoned engineering structures.

§oThese structures often contain very useful items that will definitely come in handy!
questlog.quest.backpacks.title: Backpacks
questlog.quest.backpacks.description:
§lBackpacks§r are an indispensable companion on any journey, which is why we've paid special attention to them:

• Backpack balance has been completely reworked.
• All recipes have been completely changed.
• The most advanced backpacks require mechanical crafting.

§c§l⚠ Warning! When upgrading a backpack, items in it are not preserved!
questlog.quest.bosses.title: Bosses
questlog.quest.bosses.description:
§lBosses§r are the most formidable foes, some of which can challenge players at any stage of the game.

The modpack includes bosses from the following mods:
• Cataclysm 
• Bosses'Rise 
• Legendary Monsters 

Keep in mind that Cataclysm bosses are the most difficult to defeat, but their loot is also the most valuable.
To make bosses easier to find, you can craft a special eye for each of them.
questlog.quest.creative.title: Unlimited power!
questlog.quest.creative.description:
Well then, it's time to make magic work §lfor you.§r

Thanks to magic ingots, you can completely forget about food with the help of the [Infinite Ham](image:questlog:textures/icons/okorok.png), find anything you need with the [Explorer's Compass](image:questlog:textures/icons/compass.png), and never worry about fuel again with the [Creative Tank](image:questlog:textures/icons/creative_tank.png).

But all of this pales in comparison to the most cherished dream of any engineer - to build a §d§lcreative motor§r.
questlog.quest.dice.title: Enigmatic dice
questlog.quest.dice.description:
§oSometimes, after performing some action, you'll suddenly find a §d§lmysterious die§r§o in your pocket, as if fate itself is rewarding you...§r

§lMysterious Dice§r - a lucky block analog that can either reward you with unique items or harm you. It all depends purely on your luck!

§lHow to obtain them?§r
• Complete advancements
• Find them in chests around the world
• Craft them
questlog.quest.end.title: To the End!
questlog.quest.end.description:
Unfortunately, we won't be able to reach the End as quickly as the Nether...

The reason is that to activate the End portal, you'll need to collect many §lunique eyes§r. 
Some eyes are scattered around the world, others drop from certain mobs, and some can even be crafted!

§oFor a convenient overview of suitable eyes, type "@endremastered" into the JEI search bar.
questlog.quest.firearms.title: Old notes
questlog.quest.firearms.description:
Occasionally, in structures from the §oCreate§r mod, you can find records from previous civilizations - §nOld notes§r. However, to study them, we'll need special equipment:

[Researching Table](image:questlog:textures/icons/researching_table.png) - a new workstation that will help you decipher ancient records.

After deciphering, you'll unlock secret knowledge that will allow you to craft high-tech weaponry.

§oBy the way, unwanted notes can be crushed into paper.
questlog.quest.hot.title: The heat is on
questlog.quest.hot.description:
Oh dear, the §ltemperature§r in the Nether is truly §oinfernal§r. Fortunately, there's a solution:

[Soulspring Lamp](image:questlog:textures/icons/soulspring_lamp.png) - a magical item that allows you to withstand the relentless heat of the Nether while holding it in your hands.
The lamp §ogradually consumes fuel§r, but don't worry - you can always refuel it with [Soul Sprouts](image:questlog:textures/icons/soul_sprout.png) or [Banshee Powder](image:questlog:textures/icons/banshee_powder.png)!
questlog.quest.magic.title: True magic
questlog.quest.magic.description:
As you've probably already realized, the world you've entered is full of §omagic§r. This manifests in many things, but its most vivid embodiment is §d§lmagic dust§r!

This is an extremely rare resource, obtainable from objects that possess immense magical power.

Such objects include:
• [Relics](image:questlog:textures/icons/artifacts.png)
• [Enigmatic dice](image:questlog:textures/icons/dice.png)
• Enchanted [apples](image:questlog:textures/icons/ega.png) and [eggs](image:questlog:textures/icons/ege.png)
..and other magical artifacts.

§oThe dust itself has many uses, but its main value lies in the opportunity it now gives you to tame magic itself!
questlog.quest.ingot.title: Tamer of Magic
questlog.quest.ingot.description:
Although you have obtained §d§ldust§r, the magic within it is still wild and unruly, so its range of applications is rather limited. It's time for us to tame this magic by forging it into §d§lPure Magic Ingots§r!

§lFor this you will need:
• [Pearlescent Ingot](image:questlog:textures/icons/perlamutr_ingot.png) - to obtain it, you'll need to explore the far islands of the End
• Boss resources (ideally - [Ignitium ingots](image:questlog:textures/icons/ignite_ingot.png),but there are alternatives)
• Experience
• [Remnant artifact](image:questlog:textures/icons/artifact.png) - obtained through archaeology or found in dungeons
• [Magic dust](image:questlog:textures/icons/dust.png) 
• [Spiritual Crown Shards](image:questlog:textures/icons/crown_shard.png) - dropped by royal versions of mobs

§oIn ingot form, magic is far more docile and predictable, allowing you to create incredible things with it!
questlog.quest.gunhunter.title: Firearms Hunter
questlog.quest.gunhunter.description:
Notes about the most powerful weapons are extremely rare. However, even if you don't find them, there's a solution!

By collecting all types of common firearms, as well as crafting the Pneumatic Hammer, you will get notes about the §lrarest weapons§r:
• [Gatling](image:questlog:textures/icons/gatling.png)
• [Launcher](image:questlog:textures/icons/launcher.png)
questlog.quest.nether.title: The Nether
questlog.quest.nether.description: One world is far too little. Off we go - new dimension, new adventures!
